mapper.insert: INSERT INTO herb_image ( image_no, species_id, growth_record_id, image_url, original_filename, file_size, file_format, upload_source, uploader_id, distribution_id, collected_location, collected_at, image_type, growth_stage, health_status, process_status, created_at, updated_at, is_deleted ) VALUES ( #{imageNo}, #{speciesId}, #{growthRecordId}, #{imageUrl}, #{originalFilename}, #{fileSize}, #{fileFormat}, #{uploadSource}, #{uploaderId}, #{distributionId}, #{collectedLocation}, #{collectedAt}, #{imageType}, #{growthStage}, #{healthStatus}, #{processStatus}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{isDeleted} )
mapper.update: UPDATE herb_image SET species_id = #{speciesId}, growth_record_id = #{growthRecordId}, uploader_id = #{uploaderId}, distribution_id = #{distributionId}, collected_location = #{collectedLocation}, collected_at = #{collectedAt}, image_type = #{imageType}, growth_stage = #{growthStage}, health_status = #{healthStatus}, process_status = #{processStatus}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
